C1783.title: Humanity Protocol H Token Security Incident
C1783.summary: In June 2026, Humanity Protocol disclosed an H token security incident in which an attacker used keys associated with cross-chain bridge administration to steal about $32 million. The official update said the H token price fell sharply after the incident and that the team began remediation and adjusted its business direction. The case highlights risks in administrator-key custody and concentrated cross-chain bridge privileges.
